Alex Chen: Heads-up — Evergreen QBR is next Thu (3/24). Finance wants a 90/60/30 spend forecast + a short token-burn explainer. Can CS + RevOps assemble?
Priya Rao: I’ll pull 90d usage and model mix. @Sam Patel can you run cost sims with current batching + quant profiles?
Sam Patel: On it. Running sims now. Quick q — assume current Dedicated commit or hosted fallback for baseline?
Alex Chen: Use hosted baseline, but include a Dedicated commit scenario and a worst-case (cache miss) scenario. We need both for renewal negotiating.
Marta Gómez: I’ll handle enablement side — collect top 10 prompts and the primary user journeys we saw. Also flag any latency spike examples.
Priya Rao: For budget alerts, propose thresholds at 70% / 85% / 95% of committed. Should the report include cost per 1k tokens by model?
Alex Chen: Yes — per 1k tokens at model level + an effective cost-per-session metric. Example alert config (for BillingBot):
```
{"thresholds": [0.7, 0.85, 0.95], "notify": ["#customer-success","#finance"], "lookback_days": 7}
```
OnboardingBot: Reminder — Evergreen onboarding checklist: "prompt set review" pending (owner: Marta Gómez).
Marta Gómez: Will finish prompt review by EOD. FYI there are two trial users doing heavy embedding queries — could spike embedding costs.
Sam Patel: Sim results (quick): hosted baseline ~$4,200/mo; Dedicated commit (300k tokens/day) ~$3,100/mo; enabling KV prefix cache reduces token spend ~15% in our trace.
Priya Rao: Great. I’ll drop the 90/60/30 forecast and model-level per-1k into the shared sheet: https://docs.redwood.ai/sheets/evergreen-cost-sims
Alex Chen: :thumbsup: I’ll draft exec slides with three scenarios: Baseline (hosted), Dedicated commit, Optimized (cache+batch). Include renewal impact narrative.
Sam Patel: Also flagging renewal risk — renewal score sits at ~0.65 due to usage variance + open items. Mitigation ideas: price protection window, limited trial quotas, targeted enablement workshop.
Marta Gómez: Scheduling a 30-min enablement workshop with Evergreen CSM + their engineering SME within 5 business days. I’ll include the prompt walk-through and a model behavior Q&A.
Alex Chen: Action recap: Sam -> sims + populate sheet (today). Priya -> 90/60/30 forecast + per-model cost (tomorrow). Marta -> prompt review + workshop invite (EOD). I’ll own exec slides + renewal narrative. Ping here with updates.
Priya Rao: Capturing feedback from Evergreen: "responses drift on >4k context" — collect sample threads for model-quality notes.
Sam Patel: Will upload sims + cost breakdown to the sheet and @channel finance after I finish.
Marta Gómez: Also noting embed-heavy users — suggest a short limits/guardrails doc for them before renewal call.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. If anything changes with the committed numbers or trial patterns, flag immediately so we can adjust scenarios.
